description: This file contains utility functions for determining filter scope within a dashboard node tree structure, including traversal and scope calculation based on chart and tab types.

methods.name: getImmuneChartIdsFromTabsNotInScope
methods.description: Identifies chart IDs from tabs that are not in scope.

methods.name: getTabChildrenScope
methods.description: Calculates scope and immune charts for tab children based on scope parameters.

methods.name: traverse
methods.description: Recursively traverses the node tree to determine scope and immune charts based on filter ID and checked charts.

methods.name: getFilterScopeFromNodesTree
methods.description: Main exported function that initiates traversal to determine filter scope from a node tree.
